name: @stablecoinx/mcp

tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Returns which credentials this MCP currently has cached (JWT, API key, smart-account session key) and when each expires. Read-only. Always safe to call.

tools.name: auth_send_otp
tools.description: Triggers thirdweb to email a one-time code to the merchant. After the user reads the code from their inbox, call auth_verify_otp with the same email and the code. Does not return the code.

email.description: Merchant email address registered with the StablecoinX dashboard.

tools.name: auth_verify_otp
tools.description: Completes the email-OTP flow: derives the in-app smart account from email+code, signs the SIWE login payload, and exchanges it for a JWT (24h TTL). The in-app account and personal signer are kept in memory for session_key_create and vault owner calls in this process.

tools.name: auth_logout
tools.description: Deletes the local encrypted state file (JWT, API key, session key) and forgets the in-memory admin account. Does NOT revoke anything server-side - use api_key_revoke / removeSessionKey from the dashboard for that.

tools.name: api_key_create
tools.description: Creates a sk_* API key on the merchant account and caches the raw key in encrypted local storage. The raw key is NEVER returned to the caller - it is used automatically by sessions_create. Requires a fresh JWT.

mode.description: Required network class. Caches this mode independently from the other key.

tools.name: session_key_create
tools.description: Generates a new local EOA (held only by this MCP), then calls addSessionKey on the merchant's thirdweb smart account to grant that EOA constrained signing rights (target allowlist + expiry). The private key is cached in encrypted local storage. Requires auth_verify_otp to have run in this same process so the in-app admin account is available to sign the on-chain authorization.

approvedTargets.description: Contract addresses the session key may call. Empty array = key can only sign messages (e.g. SIWE), not call any contract. Use ['*'] only with extreme caution - gives the key full SA capability.

validDays.description: Days the session key remains valid. Default 30.

nativeTokenLimitPerTransactionEth.description: Cap on native value per tx, expressed in ETH as a decimal string (e.g. '0.1'). Default '0' - gas is sponsored, no native value needed.

replaceExisting.description: Set to true to acknowledge that the previous locally-cached session key (if any) will be orphaned on-chain - it remains authorized until permissionEndTimestamp but is no longer reachable via this MCP. Required to overwrite a cached session key.

tools.name: merchant_get
tools.description: Returns the current merchant's profile (id, walletAddress, name, email, onboardingCompleted, serviceFeePayer). Requires JWT.

tools.name: merchant_update
tools.description: PATCH /v1/merchants/me - update the business name shown to payers and/or the account-level service-fee payer; each field is independent, send only what changes. Setting the name for the first time flips onboardingCompleted to true. The profile email is not updatable: it is taken from the verified thirdweb login email and never overwritten.

name.description: Business name shown to payers on the checkout page.

serviceFeePayer.description: Account-level service-fee payer: MERCHANT withholds the fee from proceeds, PAYER adds it to the payer's amount due. New sessions inherit it unless sessions_create overrides it.

tools.name: api_keys_list
tools.description: Returns API keys in the selected network mode. Specify mode when both or neither key modes are cached. Raw keys are NOT returned - only prefixes, labels, and metadata.

tools.name: api_keys_revoke
tools.description: Soft-deletes the api key. Existing integrations using this key will start receiving 401. High blast radius - confirm with the user before calling.

id.description: UUID of the api key to revoke.

mode.description: Network mode; inferred from a matching cached key ID, otherwise from the sole cached mode.

tools.name: sessions_list
tools.description: GET /v1/merchants/me/sessions - paginated list of payment sessions in the selected network mode. Specify mode when both or neither key modes are cached. Read-only.

tools.name: sessions_get
tools.description: GET /v1/merchants/me/sessions/:id - full session details; the selected network mode must match the session. Specify mode when both or neither key modes are cached. Read-only.

tools.name: sessions_create
tools.description: Creates a payment session. Credentials resolve deterministically: the cached sk_* API key when one exists (POST /v1/sessions; run api_key_create once - the key survives JWT expiry), else a fresh dashboard JWT (POST /v1/merchants/me/sessions). With neither the call fails with AUTH_REQUIRED and never creates credentials itself. Exactly one request per call; a failed create is not retried through the other route.

mode.description: Network class. Required without exactly one cached key; never inferred from the API host.

idempotencyKey.description: Opaque retry key (Idempotency-Key header), scoped per merchant. Derive it from the order id: a repeated create with the same key and body returns the original session instead of minting a second one; the same key with a different body is a 409.

amount.description: Total amount in display currency, decimal string.

stakingOverride.description: Per-session override of the merchant staking policy; DEFAULT inherits it.

serviceFeePayer.description: Who pays the platform service fee for this session: MERCHANT withholds it from proceeds, PAYER adds it to the amount due. Omit to inherit the merchant's account setting.

payoutChainId.description: Normalize payout chain for this session (a supported chain id). Omit to use the merchant policy.

payoutAddress.description: Normalize payout recipient (EVM address). Omit to use the merchant policy.

metadata.description: Your correlation data; put your order id under "orderId". Flat map of string values: at most 20 keys of 1-40 characters (A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _ . -), values up to 500 characters. Returned by sessions_get/sessions_list and in every webhook event; never shown to the payer. No secrets or personal data.

tools.name: paymaster_clients_list
tools.description: GET /v1/paymaster/clients - list of publishable pmc_* clientIds with their origin / chain allowlists. Read-only.

tools.name: paymaster_clients_create
tools.description: POST /v1/paymaster/clients - mints a publishable clientId scoped to the given origins and chains. `mode` (required) fixes the network class: a live key (pmc_live_*) may only allow mainnet chains, a test key (pmc_test_*) only testnets. The clientId is safe to ship in dApp bundles.

gasMode.description: sponsored (default): the merchant pays gas; user_paid: the user pays gas in an ERC-20 via context.token; both.

tools.name: paymaster_clients_update
tools.description: PATCH /v1/paymaster/clients/:id - change label, origins, chains, or gasMode. The mode (live/test) is fixed at creation, so new chains must match it. Changing origins/chains/gasMode may break live integrations; confirm with user.

mode.description: Network scope: explicit test/live, otherwise the sole cached key mode. JWT-only or two-key callers must specify it.

gasMode.description: sponsored (default): the merchant pays gas; user_paid: the user pays gas in an ERC-20 via context.token; both.

tools.name: paymaster_clients_revoke
tools.description: DELETE /v1/paymaster/clients/:id - revokes the publishable pmc_* clientId. Existing dApps using it will stop receiving sponsorship. Confirm with user.

mode.description: Network scope: explicit test/live, otherwise the sole cached key mode. JWT-only or two-key callers must specify it.

tools.name: paymaster_allowlist_list
tools.description: GET /v1/paymaster/allowlist - contracts the merchant has approved as sponsorship targets. Read-only.

tools.name: paymaster_allowlist_add
tools.description: POST /v1/paymaster/allowlist - upserts the (chainId, contractAddress) pair as a sponsorable target. Re-posting the same pair updates the label.

mode.description: Network scope: explicit test/live, otherwise the sole cached key mode. JWT-only or two-key callers must specify it.

tools.name: paymaster_allowlist_remove
tools.description: DELETE /v1/paymaster/allowlist/:id - removes a sponsorship target. Sponsorship stops for that contract immediately. Confirm with user.

mode.description: Network scope: explicit test/live, otherwise the sole cached key mode. JWT-only or two-key callers must specify it.

tools.name: paymaster_usage_get
tools.description: GET /v1/paymaster/usage - paginated sponsorship attempts for this merchant, newest first. denied_* rows carry the refusal reason; "targets" lists every call target in execution order and "target" is the first, so a batch is one row; when no call was decoded, "targets" is empty and "target" is "0x". denied_chain, denied_entrypoint, denied_origin and denied_malformed are sampled (at most 20 rows per client and status per 10 minutes per API instance). Pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page. Read-only.

gasMode.description: Gas payment mode; mode remains a compatible alias.

networkMode.description: Network scope: explicit test/live, otherwise the sole cached key mode. JWT-only or two-key callers must specify it. Results report the applied networkMode.

mode.description: sponsored = merchant-paid gas, user_paid = gas paid in an ERC-20.

clientId.description: Publishable client id, e.g. pmc_live_abcd - not the client UUID.

tools.name: paymaster_deny_rules_list
tools.description: GET /v1/paymaster/deny-rules - senders and targets this merchant blocks from sponsorship. A deny rule is checked before the contract allowlist and wins: a matching sender or any call target is refused even when the target is allowlisted, and one denied call target refuses a whole batch (JSON-RPC -32600 "Policy denied: paymaster_blocked_by_merchant_rule"). Newest first, at most 500 items; "total" is the full count. Read-only.

tools.name: paymaster_deny_rules_add
tools.description: POST /v1/paymaster/deny-rules - upserts the (chainId, kind, address) rule. Re-posting the same triple replaces the label; omitting it clears the stored one. The address is stored lower-cased. Deny rules are checked before the contract allowlist and win, so this blocks sponsorship for that sender, or for every op with that address as any call target (a whole batch included), immediately. Confirm with user.

mode.description: Network scope: explicit test/live, otherwise the sole cached key mode. JWT-only or two-key callers must specify it.

kind.description: sender = the smart account submitting the op; target = any call target of the op (for a delegated transfer, the inner ERC-20 token); one match refuses the whole batch.

tools.name: paymaster_deny_rules_remove
tools.description: DELETE /v1/paymaster/deny-rules/:id - lifts the block; the sender or target becomes sponsorable again (subject to the contract allowlist). Confirm with user.

mode.description: Network scope: explicit test/live, otherwise the sole cached key mode. JWT-only or two-key callers must specify it.

tools.name: paymaster_limits_get
tools.description: GET /v1/paymaster/limits - sponsorship limits as three blocks: platform (harness defaults), merchant (this merchant's overrides) and effective (the lower of the two, so a merchant value can never raise the effective limit above the platform's). USD fields are microdollars (x 10^6) as decimal strings; null means no limit. The platform never sets a per-tx cap, so effective.perTxCapUsdMicros is always the merchant's own. For perUserDailyCapUsdMicros the two blocks differ in reach: the merchant's value bounds sponsored ops only, the platform's applies to every op. Read-only.

tools.name: paymaster_limits_update
tools.description: PATCH /v1/paymaster/limits - sets this merchant's overrides. An omitted field is left untouched. Effective = min(platform, merchant), so a merchant value can never raise the effective limit above the platform's - but it can still raise or lower this merchant's own override. null clears the override entirely, which loosens the effective limit back to the platform default - and for perTxCapUsdMicros to no cap at all, because the platform never sets one. perTxCapUsdMicros applies to billed sponsored ops only (Live gas; Test dollar-policy caps apply only when explicitly enabled and never debit a monetary balance); perUserDailyCapUsdMicros bounds sponsored ops only. Setting perTxCapUsdMicros also makes every billed sponsored op depend on a live ETH/USD rate: with a cap set and no rate available the op is refused with paymaster_merchant_tx_cap_unpriceable (status denied_merchant_limit); with no cap that check never runs. Both directions change sponsorship in the selected mode - confirm with user.

mode.description: Network scope: explicit test/live, otherwise the sole cached key mode. JWT-only or two-key callers must specify it.

anyOf.description: Cap on a single operation's cost (not per sender), USD microdollars (x 10^6), 1..1000000000000 ($1,000,000). null clears the override.

perTxCapUsdMicros.description: Cap on a single operation's cost (not per sender), USD microdollars (x 10^6), 1..1000000000000 ($1,000,000). null clears the override.

anyOf.description: Per-sender daily cap, USD microdollars (x 10^6), 1..1000000000000 ($1,000,000). null clears the override.

perUserDailyCapUsdMicros.description: Per-sender daily cap, USD microdollars (x 10^6), 1..1000000000000 ($1,000,000). null clears the override.

perUserRatePerHour.description: Per-sender ops per hour. null clears the override.

tools.name: paymaster_activity_list
tools.description: GET /v1/merchants/me/paymaster/activity - the unified paymaster feed: settled on-chain ops merged with pre-chain attempts that never reached chain (denied/dropped/submitted), newest first. Rows carry "source": onchain or prechain; denied rows carry "reason". "targets" lists every call target of the op in execution order and "target" is the first; a batch is one row. When no call was decoded, "targets" is empty and "target" is "0x"; both are null on on-chain rows recorded without call details. Filtering by onchain_success or onchain_reverted returns on-chain rows only, any other status returns pre-chain rows only. On-chain rows cover ops attributed to this merchant for EntryPoint v0.7 and v0.8. Pre-chain rows contain recorded attempts for both versions; denied_chain, denied_entrypoint, denied_origin and denied_malformed are sampled (at most 20 rows per client and status per 10 minutes per API instance). Pagination is keyed on the timestamp alone, so ops sharing a timestamp across a page boundary can be skipped. Use paymaster_overview_get for aggregates without pagination loss; its attempt totals still exclude unrecorded denials. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page. Read-only.

gasMode.description: Gas payment mode; mode remains a compatible alias.

networkMode.description: Network scope: explicit test/live, otherwise the sole cached key mode. JWT-only or two-key callers must specify it. Results report the applied networkMode.

mode.description: Filters on the chain-proved mode; on-chain rows recorded without a mode are excluded from a filtered result.

cursor.description: ISO timestamp from the previous page's nextCursor; returns rows strictly older than it.

tools.name: paymaster_overview_get
tools.description: GET /v1/merchants/me/paymaster/overview - aggregate sponsorship stats for this merchant: totals (ops, successes, reverts, gas cost, sponsored vs denied attempts) plus a per-chain breakdown, lifetime and inside the selected window. Testnet chains are flagged isTestnet and use simulated billing after activation. On-chain figures (totalOps, successCount, revertCount, gas cost) cover settled ops attributed to this merchant for EntryPoint v0.7 and v0.8. The sponsoredOps / deniedOps counters count recorded attempts for both versions; denied_chain, denied_entrypoint, denied_origin and denied_malformed are sampled (at most 20 rows per client and status per 10 minutes per API instance). These aggregates avoid pagination loss but cannot recover unrecorded denials. The separate settled on-chain figures are not subject to this attempt-recording cap. Read-only.

mode.description: Network scope: explicit test/live, otherwise the sole cached key mode. JWT-only or two-key callers must specify it.

window.description: Default 24h. Windowed figures are the window* fields; the others are lifetime.

tools.name: paymaster_recent_ops
tools.description: GET /v1/merchants/me/paymaster/overview/recent-ops - the merchant's most recent settled on-chain ops (chain, EntryPoint version, tx hash, sender, success, gas cost), newest first. Only settled ops attributed to this merchant for EntryPoint v0.7 and v0.8 - use paymaster_activity_list to see recorded attempts that never reached chain. Read-only.

mode.description: Network scope: explicit test/live, otherwise the sole cached key mode. JWT-only or two-key callers must specify it.

tools.name: paymaster_balance_get
tools.description: GET /v1/merchants/me/balance - Live returns the sole monetary prepaid balance and spend; Test returns informational gas-cost estimates with billing=estimate_only and no balance fields. Test requires no funding and never creates monetary holds or debits. Amounts are USD microdollars (x 10^6) as decimal strings. Requires mode unless exactly one key mode is cached. Read-only.

tools.name: webhooks_create
tools.description: POST /v1/webhooks - registers a new webhook endpoint. Returns the endpoint summary and rawSecret (shown once - cache it). Requires an API key (sk_*).

mode.description: Routing mode: explicit test/live, otherwise the sole cached key mode. The endpoint is always assigned that mode.

events.description: Event types to subscribe to. Defaults to ["session.confirming"]. Valid: "session.confirming" (payment detected, settlement starting — no result fields), "session.partial" (funds arrived below the session amount; amountReceived is the leading chain's received amount; per-chain balances are in amountReceivedByChain), "session.completed" (tokens delivered, payload carries what landed: deliveredChainId and deliveredAssets [{ symbol, tokenAddress, decimals, amount }] with raw on-chain amounts, plus tokenReceived, usdeAmount, sUsdeAmount, and payoutChainId/payoutAddress — the normalize payout target, present only when one was configured), "session.expired" (the session expired unpaid or partially paid; carries the final amountPaid and amountRemaining), "session.cancelled" (the merchant cancelled the unpaid session — terminal; carries cancelledAt), "session.payment_detected" (any observed increase in an underpaying session's per-chain balance, including sub-cent deposits; carries amountPaid and amountRemaining), "session.failed" (settlement failed after payment was detected; carries failureReason), "balance.low" (prepaid balance running low; data.balance carries balanceUsd, burnRatePerDayUsd and daysLeft — no session) and "balance.exhausted" (prepaid balance ran out and sponsored operations stop; data.balance carries balanceUsd — no session).

apiVersion.description: Pin the endpoint's payload shape to a contract version (currently "2026-10-02"). Omit for latest — the shape may then evolve.

tools.name: webhooks_list
tools.description: GET /v1/webhooks - lists endpoints in the selected mode, including unassigned endpoints during server preparation. Requires an API key (sk_*).

tools.name: webhooks_delete
tools.description: DELETE /v1/webhooks/:id - permanently removes a webhook endpoint. Active deliveries in flight may still complete. Confirm with user. Requires an API key (sk_*).

tools.name: webhooks_rotate_secret
tools.description: POST /v1/webhooks/:id/rotate-secret - generates a new signing secret. The old secret stops working immediately. Returns new rawSecret (shown once). Requires an API key (sk_*).

tools.name: webhooks_deliveries
tools.description: GET /v1/merchants/me/webhooks/:id/deliveries - paginated delivery history for a webhook endpoint in the selected network mode. Specify mode when both or neither key modes are cached. Requires a fresh JWT.

status.description: "exhausted" selects deliveries whose automatic retries ran out.

tools.name: webhooks_delivery
tools.description: GET /v1/merchants/me/webhooks/:id/deliveries/:deliveryId - one delivery attempt with its retained payload (the exact body that was signed and sent) and the endpoint's response; the selected network mode must match. Specify mode when both or neither key modes are cached. Requires a fresh JWT.

tools.name: webhooks_resend_delivery
tools.description: POST /v1/webhooks/:id/deliveries/:deliveryId/resend - replays a retained delivery's stored payload unchanged to its original endpoint, which must still be enabled and subscribed to the event type (404 webhook_no_enabled_endpoints otherwise). Answers 202; the resend rate limits of retry-webhook apply (409/429 with a code). Requires an API key (sk_*).

tools.name: yield_deployments_list
tools.description: GET /v1/merchants/me/yield-deployments — paginated list of the merchant's yield deployments (floYsh YaaS), newest first. sunset=false (default) lists the active deployments; sunset=true lists the archive. The two views are disjoint. Each item carries status, chainId, branding, internalHostname and sunsetAt. Read-only. Accepts a fresh JWT or a cached sk_* key.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

sunset.description: true = the archive (sunset deployments) instead of the active list.

tools.name: yield_deployments_create
tools.description: POST /v1/merchants/me/yield-deployments — creates a yield deployment in status "draft" with its branding, and allocates its internal hostname (<slug>.floysh.<domain>, derived from the name) automatically. chainId is immutable afterwards. Fails with 409 when the merchant is at the per-merchant deployment limit. Returns the deployment detail (domains, contracts). Requires a fresh JWT.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

name.description: Internal name shown in the dashboard; also seeds the internal hostname slug.

chainId.description: Network id for this vault; query yield_deployments_deploy_options for deployment availability.

displayName.description: Name shown to depositors on the tenant site.

theme.description: Branding theme published to the tenant site. The logo is set with yield_deployments_logo_upload.

tools.name: yield_deployments_get
tools.description: GET /v1/merchants/me/yield-deployments/:id — one yield deployment with its domains (internal + custom, each with a provisioning status) and contracts. 404 when the id is not one of the merchant's. Read-only. Accepts a fresh JWT or a cached sk_* key.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

tools.name: yield_deployments_update
tools.description: PATCH /v1/merchants/me/yield-deployments/:id — updates the name and/or branding (displayName, theme); at least one must be given and only the given fields change. Renaming does not move the internal hostname; chainId and status cannot be changed here. Returns the updated detail. Requires a fresh JWT.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

theme.description: Branding theme published to the tenant site. The logo is set with yield_deployments_logo_upload.

tools.name: yield_deployments_delete
tools.description: DELETE /v1/merchants/me/yield-deployments/:id — permanently deletes a yield deployment that is still in status "draft" (409 otherwise); a launched deployment is retired with yield_deployments_sunset instead. Confirm with the user. Requires a fresh JWT.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

tools.name: yield_deployments_sunset
tools.description: POST /v1/merchants/me/yield-deployments/:id/sunset — retires a launched yield deployment: it moves from the active list to the archive and its tenant hosts stop serving it. Drafts cannot be sunset (409; delete them instead). Idempotent. Reversible with yield_deployments_unsunset. Confirm with the user. Requires a fresh JWT.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

tools.name: yield_deployments_unsunset
tools.description: DELETE /v1/merchants/me/yield-deployments/:id/sunset — returns a sunset yield deployment to the active list and republishes its tenant config. Restores visibility only; the deployment's status is untouched. Idempotent. Requires a fresh JWT.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

tools.name: yield_deployments_domain_add
tools.description: POST /v1/merchants/me/yield-deployments/:id/domains — attaches a custom domain (kind "custom") to a yield deployment. It starts in status "pending" and stays there until the customer's DNS and the TLS certificate are provisioned. 400 for an invalid hostname, 409 when the hostname is already in use. Returns the new domain. Requires a fresh JWT.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

tools.name: yield_deployments_domain_remove
tools.description: DELETE /v1/merchants/me/yield-deployments/:id/domains/:domainId — removes a custom domain from a yield deployment; it stops serving immediately. The internal (kind "internal") domain cannot be removed (409). Confirm with the user. Requires a fresh JWT.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

tools.name: yield_deployments_logo_upload
tools.description: POST /v1/merchants/me/yield-deployments/:id/logo (multipart/form-data) — uploads a logo from a local file and sets theme.logoUrl to its hosted URL, replacing any previous logo. PNG, WebP or SVG (content-sniffed; scripted SVGs are rejected), at most 2 MiB. The hosted logo is publicly readable. Returns the updated deployment detail. Requires a fresh JWT.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the logo file on this machine. A relative path resolves against the MCP process cwd, not your shell.

tools.name: yield_deployments_deploy_options
tools.description: Get this merchant's owner address, platform fee, supported tokens and deployment availability on a network. Accepts JWT or sk_*.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

tools.name: yield_deployments_contract_sets
tools.description: List this merchant's deployed vault contract sets on a network, including archived source sites. Paginated; excludeVault hides the current vault. Accepts JWT or sk_*.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

tools.name: yield_deployments_deploy
tools.description: Queue a new vault for a draft or failed deployment using the same backend as Business UI. Read deploy options first. Gas is billed to prepaid balance on mainnet; Test gas produces informational cost estimates without balance funding, reservations or debits. HTTP 202 is queued, not confirmed: poll yield_deployments_get for pending/deploying/deployed/failed, failureReason and deployTxHash. Never blindly retry after a timeout; inspect status and locked deploySettings first. Requires JWT.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

initialUserBP.description: Depositor yield share in basis points. The API checks it against the platform fee.

tools.name: yield_deployments_contracts_link
tools.description: Link another of this merchant's deployed contract sets on the same chain to an unconfigured draft, or switch a live site. For a live switch explicitly provide confirmLive:true and expectedVault from the last read; another live site must keep serving the previous vault so depositors retain withdrawal access. Funds stay in the previous vault. The backend enforces these guards. Requires JWT.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

tools.name: yield_vault_get
tools.description: Read this deployment's vault overview, splits, treasury, totals and daily history from the dashboard's Envio indexer, with live on-chain share price when available. Returns sync live/behind/pending; missing indexer data is not zero. Token amounts are raw 18-decimal strings. Resolves the vault from the merchant API; accepts JWT or sk_*.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

tools.name: yield_vault_activity
tools.description: Read paginated deposits and withdrawals for this deployment's vault, newest first, with indexer sync status. Amounts are raw 18-decimal strings. Paging is limited to the first 100,000 events, as in the dashboard. Accepts JWT or sk_*.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

tools.name: yield_vault_overrides
tools.description: List explicit nonzero depositor split overrides for this deployment's vault, with indexer sync status. A zero override follows the default and is omitted. Returns an error if the bounded query cannot guarantee completeness. Accepts JWT or sk_*.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

tools.name: yield_vault_split_create
tools.description: Create an immutable split (vault limit: 50) with a depositor share in basis points. The live fee must match expectedFeeBP and leave a nonnegative owner share. Optionally make it default for future deposits; existing positions retain their split. A partial result names the created split and must not be retried as creation. Requires fresh JWT and auth_verify_otp in this process. Signs the merchant smart account on the vault's network through the SCX paymaster and bundler, billed to prepaid balance on mainnet. Before signing it ensures sponsorship exactly as the dashboard does: it may create a 'Merchant dashboard' paymaster client and allowlist the vault for the merchant's sponsored clients — both persist even if the transaction then fails. Sponsorship failure blocks the action. Indexer results can lag confirmed receipts; never blindly retry an uncertain transaction.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

expectedVault.description: Vault address from the deployment you reviewed; a changed target blocks the write.

confirm.description: Explicit acknowledgement of this owner action.

tools.name: yield_vault_split_set_default
tools.description: Choose an existing split for future deposits. Existing positions retain their split. Checks the live fee and split terms before signing. Requires fresh JWT and auth_verify_otp in this process. Signs the merchant smart account on the vault's network through the SCX paymaster and bundler, billed to prepaid balance on mainnet. Before signing it ensures sponsorship exactly as the dashboard does: it may create a 'Merchant dashboard' paymaster client and allowlist the vault for the merchant's sponsored clients — both persist even if the transaction then fails. Sponsorship failure blocks the action. Indexer results can lag confirmed receipts; never blindly retry an uncertain transaction.

mode.description: Network mode; required unless exactly one key mode is cached.

expectedVault.description: Vault address from the deployment you reviewed; a changed target blocks the write.

confirm.description: Explicit acknowledgement of this owner action.

tools.name: yield_vault_treasury_set
tools.description: Change the address receiving the owner's yield share. Pending cooldown payouts use the treasury in effect when claimed. Review the destination before confirming. Requires fresh JWT and auth_verify_otp in this process. Signs the merchant smart account on the vault's network through the SCX paymaster and bundler, billed to prepaid balance on mainnet. Before signing it ensures sponsorship exactly as the dashboard does: it may create a 'Merchant dashboard' paymaster client and allowlist the vault for the merchant's sponsored clients — both persist even if the transaction then fails. Sponsorship failure blocks the action. Indexer results can lag confirmed receipts; never blindly retry an uncertain transaction.

tools.name: tools_batch
tools.description: Call 1-20 tools in one request with all arguments known in advance. Consecutive reads run in parallel (up to 4); writes run one at a time in input order and form barriers between read groups. The first observed error stops new calls; already-started reads finish. Returns every completed result, error and skipped call in input order. Validates all names/arguments before execution. Uses the same auth checks and secret filtering as individual tools. No nested batches, result references, retries or rollback. Inspect partial results before retrying writes.

id.description: Unique call ID, used to correlate results.

tool.description: An existing tool on this server; tools_batch cannot be nested.

instructions:
StablecoinX provides stablecoin payments, managed gas sponsorship and floYsh / Yield as a Service (YaaS).

Use tools_batch when several tool calls have known arguments: consecutive reads run in parallel, writes run sequentially in input order, and any error stops new calls while preserving completed results. Check each result status; batches are not transactions and must not be blindly retried after a write.

For gas sponsorship, StablecoinX provides both the paymaster RPC (https://api.harness.stablecoinx.com/v1/paymaster/rpc) and a bundler proxy (https://api.harness.stablecoinx.com/v1/paymaster/bundler/{chainId}?clientId=<pmc_*>). Configure both transports and read the deployed contract at https://api.harness.stablecoinx.com/openapi.json and https://paymaster-ui.harness.stablecoinx.com/llms-full.txt before choosing an account flow. Besides single execute calls, the dApp's smart account can submit UserOperation batches (unrelated to tools_batch), sponsored in two formats only: executeBatch(address[],uint256[],bytes[]) (SimpleAccount v0.7, thirdweb Account) and ERC-7579 execute(bytes32,bytes) with exactly the BatchDefault mode (MetaMask smart accounts), up to 16 zero-value calls with every call target allowlisted. This is not support for arbitrary ERC-7579 accounts or SimpleAccount v0.8 batches, and the allowlist checks addresses, not call arguments.

For transfers from an existing MetaMask Smart Account, use bounded Advanced Permissions (wallet_requestExecutionPermissions, erc20-token-allowance) and a separate session smart account to sign the UserOperation. This differs from the SimpleAccount flow and is not arbitrary ERC-7579 support. MCP tools configure merchant sponsorship and inspect activity; the dApp requests wallet permission and submits the operation. See the bundled references/metamask-advanced-permissions.md guide and check the deployed reference for supported networks and caveats.

floYsh is a branded stablecoin-yield site built around Ethena USDe/sUSDe vaults. Merchants manage deployments, branding and domains in Business UI; customers connect a wallet on the deployment's public site to access the vault.

For floYsh, use yield_deployments_* tools to manage deployments, branding, domains and vault deployment/selection. Use yield_vault_* to read analytics and change owner settings. The corresponding Business UI page is https://business.harness.stablecoinx.com/deployments/yield. Obtain the public-site hostname and custom-domain DNS target from yield_deployments_get.

Product guide and navigation: https://business.harness.stablecoinx.com/llms-full.txt. Merchant configuration API: https://api.harness.stablecoinx.com/docs#/yield-deployments; machine-readable spec: https://api.harness.stablecoinx.com/docs/openapi.json (merchant JWT required).

Creating a yield deployment creates a draft. Deployment is asynchronous: inspect status and failureReason before treating it as ready. Vault writes require an active OTP wallet in this process, expectedVault and confirm:true; split writes also check the live fee against expectedFeeBP. Never repeat split creation after partial success or an uncertain transaction. Reads use the cached sk_* or JWT; configuration and owner writes require JWT.
